The structure of Li4Al4Co2O12 (reduced formula Li2Al2CoO6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 216), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Co each adopt octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Li centers have four O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Al and Co octahedra and edge-sharing between Al octahedra are observed, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity network.
